title: Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan Terms Schedule: Early Termination Fees and Refund Timing
content:
Schedule to the Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan terms. For each plan it states whether the tenant may end the plan before its term ends, the fee deducted from an early-termination refund, how that refund is computed, the free-cancellation period after the prepayment, and how and when refunds are paid.

## Part A. Fees and periods

| Plan | Tenant may end the plan early | Fee deducted from an early-termination refund | Free-cancellation period (calendar days after the prepayment) | Refund issued within (calendar days after early termination) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 3-Month Plan | Yes | $0.00 (no fee) | 7 | 21 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 6-Month Plan | Yes | $25.00 | 7 | 21 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 9-Month Plan | Yes | $25.00 | 7 | 21 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 12-Month Plan | Yes | $35.00 | 14 | 21 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 18-Month Plan | Yes | $50.00 | 14 | 30 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 24-Month Plan | Yes | $50.00 | 14 | 30 |

## Part B. Bases common to all six plans

| Term | Under every plan |
|---|---|
| How an early-termination refund is computed | The prepayment less the months already applied, each valued at the standard monthly rent |
| Discount and free months already used are taken back on early termination | Yes |
| A partly used billing period is refunded | No |
| How refunds are paid | To the original payment method |
| A cancellation made after the free-cancellation period | Treated as an early termination |

## Notes

1. "Taken back" means that each month already applied counts at the monthly rent without the plan discount and without the benefit of a free month when the refund is worked out.
2. Under every plan, no part of a partly used billing period is refunded.
3. Hypothetical comparison: a tenant ending a 3-month plan early has no fee deducted, while a tenant ending a 24-month plan early has $50.00 deducted and receives the refund within 30 calendar days rather than 21.
